holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit reached ₹16,276 crore in June 2026 compared to ₹14,456 crore in June 2025.
The bank received a GST show-cause notice on September 30, 2026 demanding ₹229.14 crore along with interest and penalty.
Anup Bagchi resigned as MD and CEO of ICICI Life effective October 13, 2026, succeeded by Sidharatha Mishra.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the largest fund holding at 8.66% and contributed to portfolio drag with a 3-month return of -3.30%, compounding financial sector weakness.

watch.text: Q2 results scheduled to be reported during mid-October 2026.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Anup Bagchi was appointed as Managing Director and CEO for three years starting October 27, 2026.
Foreign institutional investors reduced their stake by 2.4% during the September 2026 quarter.
As of September 2026, advances stood at ₹33,075 billion and deposits reached ₹33,275 billion.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding an 8.48% position, HDFC Bank is the fund's largest negative contributor over the 3-month period (-1.21% contribution on a -14.27% return).

watch.text: Leadership transition taking effect on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Sales rose to ₹309,468 crore in June 2026, though operating margin moderated to 15% from 18% in June 2025.
The company allotted ₹13,008.6 crore of unsecured NCDs at a 7.90% coupon due October 2036.
A customs order imposed a fine and penalty of ₹18,74,978, which the company decided to appeal.

expected.text: Reports project European diesel shortages could lift Q2 O2C earnings by 38% to ₹20,700 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 6.26% weight, Reliance is the fund's second-biggest negative contributor over 3 months (-0.658% contribution on a -10.51% decline).

watch.text: Developments and pricing details surrounding the proposed Jio Platforms listing.

holdings.name: Sterlite Technologies Ltd

what_changed.text: A subsidiary secured a long-term supply agreement for optical connectivity products worth approximately USD 1.2 billion through December 2030.
Net profit expanded to ₹197 crore in June 2026 from ₹10 crore in June 2025, with operating margin climbing to 20%.

expected.text: Nomura initiated coverage forecasting nearly 50% upside in the stock.
Nirmal Bang initiated coverage projecting up to 40% upside.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 5.70% weight and an 86.94% 3-month gain, Sterlite Technologies was the top performance contributor (+4.956%), largely offsetting large-cap losses elsewhere.

watch.text: Board meeting and earnings call scheduled for October 23, 2026 to review Q2 FY2026 results.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T secured an LNTP for the 2x800 MW Chandrapura thermal power project in Jharkhand.
The PT&D unit won multiple mega EPC orders across Saudi Arabia, UAE, and India in early October 2026.
The timeline to complete the stake sale in L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad was extended to December 31, 2026.

expected.text: Motilal Oswal projected 19% upside for the stock.

holdings.why_it_matters: Carrying a 5.36% allocation, L&T's 3-month return of -6.15% exerted a -0.330% drag on fund performance.

watch.text: Execution of the extended stake sale in L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad by December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Quarterly sales reached ₹20,211 crore in June 2026 compared to ₹7,167 crore in June 2025.
Operating profit reached ₹594 crore in June 2026 from ₹115 crore in June 2025.
The company obtained an ESG score of 76.00 and a Leader band rating for FY2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 4.56% weight, Zomato delivered an 11.67% return over 3 months, adding +0.532% to total fund return.

watch.text: Impact of clarification regarding 5% GST application on platform apps.

holdings.name: Shriram Transport Finance Company Ltd

what_changed.text: The company settled a tender offer buying back $460 million of notes due 2027 and 2028 on September 30, 2026.
The Income Tax Department levied a penalty of ₹67.9 crore for AY 2009-10, which the company is appealing.
Net profit for June 2026 grew to ₹3,453 crore from ₹2,159 crore in June 2025.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 4.48% of the fund, the stock dropped -9.93% over 3 months, creating a -0.445% negative contribution.

watch.text: Outcome of the appeal against the ₹67.9 crore income tax penalty.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: Net profit for the quarter ended June 2026 rose to ₹25,121 crore from ₹22,121 crore in June 2025.
SBI purchased nearly 40% of Reliance's $1.35 billion debt offering.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 3.83% of the portfolio, SBI fell -7.42% over 3 months, reinforcing the broader decline across banking assets.

watch.text: Consolidation plans regarding its primary dealership stake.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: The company launched new postpaid plans featuring free international roaming on October 8, 2026.
Airtel Business introduced IQ Gateway, an enterprise communications platform compliant with DPDP rules.
The Department of Telecommunications levied minor penalties totaling under ₹12 lakh over subscriber verification rules.

holdings.why_it_matters: Bharti Airtel forms 3.50% of the portfolio and declined -6.00% over 3 months, tracking general weakness in mega-cap holdings.

watch.text: Revenue and subscriber impact following the postpaid tariff changes.

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: September 2026 sales climbed to 113,705 units with production reaching 121,722 units.
The company agreed to sell a 51% stake in Novavayu Aerospace to Embraer for ₹5,10,000 by December 1, 2026.
Net profit rose to ₹5,998 crore in June 2026 from ₹4,377 crore in June 2025.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.94% weight, M&M's 3-month return of -10.65% clipped fund performance by -0.313%.

watch.text: Closing of the 51% Novavayu Aerospace sale to Embraer by December 1, 2026.
Regulatory clearance for Lightrock Group's investment in Mahindra Last Mile Mobility.

portfolio.statement: The fund lost 3.43% over the past three months as steep drops in top banking and energy holdings outweighed sharp gains in mid-sized technology holdings.
interp: Heavy exposure to large financials (HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Shriram Transport, SBI totaling over 25%) drove the bulk of the portfolio's decline.
An exceptional 86.94% quarterly rally in Sterlite Technologies provided nearly 5 percentage points of positive contribution, dampening overall fund losses.
portfolio.line: Financial drag countered by standalone tech outperformance.

drivers.text: Sterlite Technologies added 4.956% to fund performance over 3 months, driven by strong operational expansion and a USD 1.2 billion supply contract.
HDFC Bank subtracted 1.21% from the fund over 3 months amidst foreign institutional outflows of 2.4% in the September quarter.
Reliance Industries subtracted 0.658% over 3 months alongside declining operating profit margins in recent quarters.

themes.title: Banking and Financial Retrenchment
themes.text: Major financial holdings experienced significant selling pressure over 3 months despite steady net earnings, with HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Shriram Transport falling between 3% and 15%.

themes.title: Telecom & Digital Network Momentum
themes.text: Network infrastructure and consumer digital services delivered positive performance, supported by optical connectivity contract wins and commercial launches.

macro.factor: Interest Rates and Bank Credit Margins
macro.why: Interest rate pressures have created negative stock sentiment for large lenders despite steady balance sheet deposit and advance expansion.
Fluctuations in refining and chemical product spreads influence operating margins and cash flows for diversified energy operators.

priced_in.text: Sterlite Technologies' USD 1.2 billion optical connectivity agreement through 2030 and sequential margin expansion are reflected in its multi-fold share price rally.
HDFC Bank's leadership succession to Anup Bagchi and recent foreign institutional selling of 2.4% are reflected in its 27.62% one-year drawdown.

could_change.title: Jio Platforms Listing Timelines
could_change.text: Formalization of the Jio Platforms IPO structure and price band could alter valuation sentiment around parent Reliance Industries.

could_change.title: New Leadership Execution at HDFC Bank
could_change.text: The incoming MD & CEO taking charge on October 27, 2026 could influence business strategy and institutional investor positioning.

portfolio.risk_note: Financials represent 33.4% of the fund across banks and NBFCs, creating high vulnerability to sector-wide credit and margin developments.
